evidence.observation: Ramp temperature 749.4 °C closely tracks the 749.6 °C setpoint.
At growth transition, temperature briefly overshoots to 761.4 °C while heater power drops to 40.2%.
Temperature settles toward the 750 °C setpoint at 752.5 °C, with heater power 42.2%, consistent with a resolving transition transient.
Argon 100.1 sccm matches the 100 sccm setpoint; pressure remains stable at 760.4 Torr, oxygen is low at 3.9 ppm, and controller reports running.
